_doc: Ground marks as decals on the depth (Prender-272, marks.gdshader): a blow of force 20 on bare earth outside the town (900, 900) ({at: [x, z]}; setView's y is the map's north, -z, so the crater stands at setView (900, -900)); a blow on a street digs none (Psimulation-106). Two seconds after it, the crater near (20 px a metre) from 45 degrees at four azimuths, at street level (10 degrees), from above (85) and mid (8): the hole, its lip and the scorch lie on the ground, following its rise and fall.
